description: Formula weight from a chemical formula (Hill notation, IUPAC/CIAAW weights) — Parses a chemical formula (parentheses, brackets, hydrate dots such as CuSO4·5H2O, an ignored charge) for a chemist or an agent that must check a molar mass, and returns the Hill-notation formula, the formula weight in g/mol from the CIAAW abridged standard atomic weights summed exactly in decimal arithmetic, and mass fractions. Pass claimedWeight and tolerance to check a stated molar mass. Elemen

claimedWeight.description: Stated molar mass to check, g/mol.

elementWeights.description: Caller-chosen weights; they take precedence over the table and are the only way to weigh elements without a standard atomic weight.

formula.description: Chemical formula, at most 200 characters. Element symbols are case-sensitive (Co is cobalt, CO is carbon monoxide). Hydrate separators: . · • *. A trailing charge such as ^2+, 2- after a bracket, or a bare + or - is ignored.

mode.description: formula (default) computes the weight; smiles validates syntax only.

smiles.description: A single SMILES string without a name, at most 200 characters (mode smiles).

tolerance.description: Allowed absolute difference from claimedWeight in g/mol. Default 0.01.

name: formula-weight
